title: Family with Newborn Outside Home, 1949 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
May 1949

Louise, Kerry, Linda
(holding Harold) and
Betty.
description: A delightful mid-century family snapshot captured outdoors in May 1949. Two stylishly dressed women and three children—including a newborn bundled in blankets—pose together near the stone base of a suburban home. The women wear tailored postwar jackets and full skirts, reflecting the emerging post-WWII domestic boom and family-centric American culture.
